tera-.translation:
[计] 太, 万亿
[化] 太拉

terabit.definition: n. a unit of information equal to 1000 gigabits or 10^12 (1,000,000,000,000) bits

terabyte.definition:
n. a unit of information equal to 1000 gigabytes or 10^12 (1,000,000,000,000) bytes
n. a unit of information equal to 1024 gibibytes or 2^40 (1,099,511,627,776) bytes

terabytes.definition:
plural of terabyte
n. a unit of information equal to 1000 gigabytes or 10^12 (1,000,000,000,000) bytes
n. a unit of information equal to 1024 gibibytes or 2^40 (1,099,511,627,776) bytes
terabytes.translation: (terabyte 的复数) [计] 太字节(万亿字节)

teracalorie.translation: 兆兆(=10的12次方)卡, 万亿卡

teraconic acid.translation: [化] 芸康酸; 异亚丙基丁二酸

teracrylic acid.translation:
[化] 2,3-二甲基-2-戊烯酸
[医] 庚烯-3,4-酸

teraflop.translation: [网络] 万亿次浮点计算；浮点运算；万亿次浮点运算

teraflops.definition: n. (computer science) a unit for measuring the speed of a computer system
teraflops.translation: n. 每秒万亿次浮点运算

terahertz.definition: n. one trillion periods per second

terai.translation: n. 特赖帽, 阔边毡帽

terakihi.translation: n. [鱼]唇指鲈(新西兰产的一种食用鱼)

teram.translation: 楼梯踏步端头旋涡形装饰

teran.translation: 特朗酒(南斯拉夫产红葡萄酒)

teraphim.definition:
n. pl. Images connected with the magical rites used by those
   Israelites who added corrupt practices to the patriarchal religion.
   Teraphim were consulted by the Israelites for oracular answers.
teraphim.translation: n. 家庭供奉的小神像( teraph的名词复数 )

teraphs.translation: n. 家庭供奉的小神像

teras.definition:
n (medicine) a grossly malformed and usually nonviable fetus
n a three-tone Chadic language

terata.definition: n (medicine) a grossly malformed and usually nonviable fetus

terata anadidyma.translation: [医] 上身联胎, 双下身联胎

terata catadidyma.translation: [医] 下身联胎, 双上身联胎

teratic implantation.translation: [医] 植入法[畸胎]畸形(不完全胎儿与几乎完全胎儿的部分融合)

teratismus hermaphroditicus.translation: [医] 两性畸形, 雌雄同体[畸形]

teratogen.definition: n any agent that interferes with normal embryonic development: alcohol or thalidomide or X-rays or rubella are examples

teratogenesis.definition: n the development of defects in an embryo

teratogenic.definition: a. of or relating to substances or agents that can interfere with normal embryonic development
teratogenic.translation:
a. 畸形发生的
[医] 畸形形成的

teratogenicity.translation: n. [生]畸形形成性, 致畸性

teratogennicity.translation: 畸胎性,[医]畸形发生, 畸胎形成

teratogens.definition:
plural of teratogen
n any agent that interferes with normal embryonic development: alcohol or thalidomide or X-rays or rubella are examples
teratogens.translation: (teratogen 的复数) n.[生]致畸剂,畸胎剂

teratogeny.translation:
n. 畸形发生, 畸胎形成
[医] 畸形形成, 畸形发生

teratoid.definition:
a. Resembling a monster; abnormal; of a pathological growth,
   exceedingly complex or highly organized.

teratological.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to teratology; as, teratological
   changes.
teratological.translation: a. 畸形学的, 畸形生长的

teratology.definition: n. the branch of biology concerned with the development of malformations or serious deviations from the normal type of organism
teratology.translation:
n. 畸形学, 神怪故事集
[医] 畸形学, 畸胎学

teratoma.definition: n a tumor consisting of a mixture of tissues not normally found at that site

teratoma autochthonum.translation: [医] 本地发生性畸胎瘤, 原地发生性畸胎瘤

teratophobia.translation: 畸形恐怖, 畸胎恐怖
